# Review protocol

All four reviewers follow this protocol.
Your agent file adds what you specifically check and any extra output section.

## Inputs (paths come in your prompt)
- `<job>/spec.md` and `<job>/build.md`.
- `<worktree>` on branch `my-factory/<job-id>`.
- The round number `<n>` and your output file `<job>/round-<n>/review-<role>.md`.

## Gather context
1. Read spec.md, then build.md.
2. See what changed:
   - `git -C <worktree> log main..HEAD --oneline`
   - `git -C <worktree> diff main...HEAD --stat`
   - `git -C <worktree> diff main...HEAD`
3. Read whole files where the diff is not enough to judge the change.
4. If the diff touches nothing in your area, write a PASS that says so in one line and stop.

## Later rounds (n > 1)
1. Read your own previous review: `<job>/round-<n-1>/review-<role>.md`.
2. See what the builder changed since then: the round log in build.md and `git -C <worktree> log` for the new commits.
3. For each earlier finding, state `fixed`, `not fixed`, or `disputed` (the builder explained why in build.md; accept the reason or explain why it does not hold).
4. Then review only the new changes for regressions. Do not raise new nitpicks on code that did not change.

## Grading
- **blocker**: wrong behaviour, an unmet acceptance criterion, a failing check, data loss, or a security hole.
- **major**: a real problem a user or maintainer will hit, which should be fixed before merge.
- **minor**: polish or preference; worth noting, never blocking.
- Only raise findings you can point to: a file and line, a screenshot, or a command and its output.
- Issues in files the change touches count even if they already existed, when they are cheap to fix along.

## Verdict
- `VERDICT: CHANGES` if there is at least one blocker or major finding; otherwise `VERDICT: PASS`.
- The verdict is the exact first line of your file, with nothing before it.

## File format
Write exactly one file, your review, and do not modify anything else.

```markdown
VERDICT: PASS | CHANGES

## Previous findings
(rounds 2+ only)
- [fixed|not fixed|disputed] <finding> - <one line on why>

## Findings
- [blocker|major|minor] `path/file.py:42` - problem. Required change: ...

## <Section named in your agent file>
...
```

Finish by replying with the verdict line only.
